events.text: An agricultural drone worth 55,000 yuan, financed by a licensed lessor. The pilot had nothing to pledge. The lease is spread over 13,750 mu of spraying, 13,580 mu are done and 650 yuan are left. Farmers pay per mu. Every confirmed fee repays the lease, fills the pilot bond and pays the drone.

Two bonds. The pilot bond, 350 yuan so far, is earned from fees and pays only for the pilot's own cheating. The vendor bond, 5000 yuan posted up front by the company that built the agent, pays for the agent's mistakes: 200 yuan per proven violation, at most 1000 yuan a day. The pilot never pays for the AI.
